mapper.select: select tmp.*, cm.Mea_Code as meaCode, cm.Mea_Start_Time as meaStartTime, cm.Mea_End_Time as meaEndTime from ( select mn.mea_id as meaId, sum(Mear_Declared_Total) as declaredAmt, sum(Mear_Final_Total) as examineAmt, (select count(*) from Con_Measure_Record where Mea_Id=mn.mea_id and State=7) as declaredNum, (select count(distinct rc.Mear_Id) from Con_Measure_Record_Check rc left join Con_Measure_Record mr on mr.id=rc.Mear_Id where mr.Mea_Id=mn.mea_id and mr.State=7) as examineNum from Con_Measure_Record mn left join Con_Measure mea on mn.mea_id=mea.id where mn.State=7 and mea.State=7 and mn.mea_id in (select cpm.mea_id from Con_Pay_Measure cpm where cpm.pay_id=#{payId}) group by mn.mea_id) tmp left join Con_Measure cm on cm.id=tmp.meaId

select tmp.*, cm.Mea_Code as meaCode, cm.Mea_Start_Time as meaStartTime, cm.Mea_End_Time as meaEndTime from ( select mn.mea_id as meaId, sum(Mear_Declared_Total) as declaredAmt, sum(Mear_Final_Total) as examineAmt, (select count(*) from Con_Measure_Record where Mea_Id=mn.mea_id and State=7) as declaredNum, (select count(distinct rc.Mear_Id) from Con_Measure_Record_Check rc left join Con_Measure_Record mr on mr.id=rc.Mear_Id where mr.Mea_Id=mn.mea_id and mr.State=7) as examineNum from Con_Measure_Record mn left join Con_Measure mea on mn.mea_id=mea.id where mea.con_id=#{conId} and mn.State=7 and mea.State=7
and mn.mea_id not in (select cpm.mea_id from Con_Pay_Measure cpm left join con_pay cp on cp.pay_id=cpm.pay_id where cp.Pay_State!=3 and cpm.Con_id=#{conId}) group by mn.mea_id ) tmp left join Con_Measure cm on cm.id=tmp.meaId
